# Reference and remaining-menu audit — 16 October 2026

Reviewed 726 saved directory references and 109 canonical zero-food branch gaps. This completes the saved reference audit, not full menu coverage. No new foods or identity approvals.

Review of saved independently sourced evidence and exact written premises, not a new HTTP check or dietary/Google identity approval. Original source check dates and all canonical food/premise/option holds remain authoritative. No food extraction, branch clone, menu transfer or publication change.

The frozen batch10 scope pass is399/399. Together with706 additional reference reviews (726 minus20 already explicitly reviewed), all1,105 independent leads have a saved review outcome.1,828 candidate IDs still lack independently attributable names; they are not classified as vegetarian.2,527 food holds remain.

Current app:175 locations,223 menus,12,084 food occurrences. Research:84 datasets,372 branch records,459 source menus,17,609 observations. All publication, source and option qualifications remain.

The review distinguishes written-address compatibility from current exact-premise confirmation. Same-candidate/name grouping does not establish branch continuity. Old Lotus extraction language is retained as history: its95 parent IDs and40 choices already exist in the canonical packet; no duplicate extraction.
